A_target.statement:
In the normal [[Definition:Modal Logic|modal logic]] $\mathsf K$, with $\Diamond \phi$ defined as $\neg \Box \neg \phi$:
:$\vdash \Diamond \paren {\phi \lor \psi} \leftrightarrow \paren {\Diamond \phi \lor \Diamond \psi}$
:$\vdash \Box \paren {\phi \to \psi} \to \paren {\Diamond \phi \to \Diamond \psi}$

B_source.statement:
In $\mathsf K$, with the axiom $\Box \paren {\phi \to \psi} \to \paren {\Box \phi \to \Box \psi}$ and the rule of [[Definition:Necessitation|necessitation]]:
:$\vdash \Box \paren {\phi \land \psi} \leftrightarrow \paren {\Box \phi \land \Box \psi}$

object_map.reformulation: Diamond is the De Morgan dual of box, exactly as the existential quantifier is dual to the universal one.

validity_conditions: Provably equivalent formulas may be replaced under box, by necessitation and the K axiom.
In Kripke semantics box means 'at all successors' and diamond 'at some successor'.
proof_plan:
